title: Simon 4.11: Jacobian chain rule through the range of a linear map
statement: Let n, N, N′ ∈ ℕ and ℝᵈ := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d). Let L : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ and A : ℝᴺ → ℝ^{N′} be continuous linear maps. Let T be a linear subspace of ℝᴺ with T = range L, with the inner product induced from ℝᴺ and inclusion ι_T = T.subtypeL : T → ℝᴺ. Then areaJacobian(A ∘ L) = areaJacobian(A ∘ ι_T) · areaJacobian(L). Here, as in the frozen contract, areaJacobian(K) = √det(K* ∘ K) for a continuous linear map K between finite-dimensional real inner product spaces, K* being the adjoint.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N N' : ℕ) (L : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn N) (A : Rn N →L[ℝ] Rn N') (T : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), T = LinearMap.range L.toLinearMap → areaJacobian (A.comp L) = areaJacobian (A.comp T.subtypeL) * areaJacobian L
